A '''champion''' is an appointed [[noble]] position which becomes available after a fortress becomes a [[baron]]y. They have no [[room]] requirements.

Other dwarves who talk to the Champion will get a special [[thought]] about "talking to a pillar of society", with the happiness bonus or penalty depending on the dwarf's [[Personality value#TRADITION|viewpoint on tradition]], and they will also satisfy their [[need]] to "uphold tradition".
